notes.title: Patch v1.0.0 – Full Controller Support, Smoother Play
notes.content:
Added
Full Controller Support
You can now play the entire game using a gamepad. Menus, gameplay, and interactions are fully supported.
Fixed
Save Controls in User Config
Control settings are now correctly saved between sessions, ensuring your preferences stay put.
Improved
Performance & UI Enhancements
Optimized game performance and made several UI adjustments for a cleaner and more responsive experience.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.2: Performance Improvements & Reduced Input Lag
notes.content:
## Fixed

- Improved overall game performance and reduced input lag for a more responsive and seamless experience
- Fixed a bug where the character could get stuck on slippery areas

notes.title: Patch 0.8.1: Fixed FPS drop and lag spikes
notes.content:
## Fixed

- Major FPS drop and physics lag resolved for smooth gameplay

notes.title: Patch 0.8.0 : Practice & Speedrun Mode – Train Smarter, Run Faster
notes.content:
## Added

- Practice Mode: Designed to help players train and optimize their runs. This includes teleportation to different key locations and the use of tools to practice each section more effectively.
- Speedrun Mode: Designed to help speedrunners track their timestamps more accurately.

## Fixed

- Minor bug fixes and general performance improvements.

notes.title: Patch 0.7.5: Performance Boost & Visual Polish Update
notes.content:
## Fixed

Performance Improvements

- Optimized map and background rendering for large scenes
- Reduced unnecessary processing in offscreen areas
- Improved memory usage and load time stability

Visual Enhancements

- Sharpened map details and polished lighting
- Enhanced visual effects for certain tiles and animations

Bug Fixes & Tweaks

- Fixed occasional stutters when entering new map zones
- Resolved minor glitches with particles and collision
- General quality-of-life improvements

notes.title: Patch 0.7.4 – Wall Jump Visual Polish & Sound Fixes
notes.content:
## Changed

- Added new UI for ending the game and displaying your score
- Polished visual effects of the cutscene

## Fixed

- Improved visual feedback for wall jumping
- Adjusted lava sound range for better spatial consistency
- Optimized overall performance
- Minor bug fixes and general improvements

notes.title: Patch 0.7.3 — Huge Performance Improvement, Controller Support & UI Refresh
notes.content:
## Added

- Full controller support for in-game movement, shop item purchases, and ability usage.

## Changed

- Refreshed the UI for "My Shell" with an updated visual design.

## Fixed

- Performance improved significantly and reduced lag input.
- Controller input issues and key misbindings.
- Various minor bugs and overall performance improvements.
- Lag issues in Hardcore mode.
- Missing death animation when touching lava.

notes.title: Patch 0.7.1 – Lava Rises, Skills Tested
notes.content:
## Added

- New Mode & Challenge: Hardcore
Test your limits in the all-new Hardcore Mode. No orbs. No items. No hidden routes. Just pure skill, map knowledge, and rising lava.

- New Soundtrack
A brand-new intense soundtrack tailored for Hardcore Mode to keep the adrenaline pumping.

- Hardcore Leaderboard
Compete globally and see how long you can survive under pressure.

- 2 New Achievements
Unlock special achievements exclusive to the Hardcore experience.

## Fixed

- Resolved an issue where the background turned grey after falling from Neon City.

- The Rattino item now works correctly, with a more balanced dash distance.

- Minor bug fixes and general improvements for a smoother experience.

notes.title: Update 0.7.0 – Dark Mode Challenge & New Leaderboards!
notes.content:
## New Content

New Challenge: Dark Mode – For those seeking a true test of skill, complete the game in total darkness.

New Leaderboards – We've added two new leaderboards to track completion with the latest changes and in Dark Mode. The previous leaderboard has been moved to the Legacy section.

New Achievement – Prove your mastery by conquering Dark Mode and earn a new achievement.

## Removed

Jump Pad Skip Removed (Stage 1) – The unintended shortcut using the jump pad has been removed for a more balanced experience.

## Fixes & Improvements

Stage 3 – Icicle Trap now properly pushes players when dashed through.

Stage 0 Route Fix – You can no longer complete Stage 0 by scaling the right wall; the intended main route must be used.

Stage 4 – Vacuum Push behavior is now limited and consistent.

Shop Exploit Fix – Resolved an issue where players could purchase multiple stacks of an item via mouse clicks.

Audio Quality Improvements – Cleaner, sharper in-game sound.

Various Minor Fixes & Performance Tweaks – General bug fixes and improvements for a smoother experience.

notes.title: Patch 0.6.1 – New achievement & balance tweaks!
notes.content:

notes.title: 🚀 Update 0.6.0 – New Skins, Stats & More!
notes.content:
What's New?

My Shell – Your Personal Collection!

- Added a new "My Shell" tab in the main menu to store your unlocked skins and track your stats.
- New Skins – Customize Your Snail!
- Unlock and equip unique snail skins to stand out in your next race!
- Stats Tracking – See Your Progress!

View detailed stats, including:
Total Jumps
Highest Reached Point
Global Rank
Best Record

Height Meter – Track Your Climb!

- Added a real-time height meter so you can see how high you've climbed.

Hidden Achievements!

- New secret achievements are waiting to be discovered—can you find them all?

notes.title: Patch 0.5.5 / Updated 02 March 2025
notes.content:

notes.title: Patch 0.5.4
notes.content:
## [0.5.4]

### Added

- "W" and "Up" keys for jumping.

### Fixed

- The moving platform speed in Stage Zero, making its movement smoother and more consistent.
- A bug that prevented the player from submitting their score to the leaderboard at the end.

### Changed

- The UI of tooltips for each item in the shop.
- The player will now teleport to the starting position instead of restarting the game after reaching the dead zone.
